C1792.title: Software Designer Wrote Evasion Remote Control Program Leading to Corporate Fraud of 9.48 Million Yuan
C1792.summary: A software designer, seeking illicit profit, developed an evasion-capable remote control program and provided it to others, who used it to illegally control corporate computer systems, resulting in a victim company being defrauded of 9.48 million yuan. The Pudong New Area Procuratorate in Shanghai prosecuted him for the crime of providing programs for illegally controlling computer information systems, and the court sentenced him to three years and two months of imprisonment plus a fine of 100,000 yuan.
